newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cairn says has 77 pct of Command.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cairn says has 77 pct of Command.

text.p: Cairn Energy Plc said on Sunday it now held acceptances for 77 percent of the issued shares of Command Petroleum Ltd following closure of the share component of its takeover offer on Friday.
Until Friday, Command shareholders could elect to receive either Cairn shares, cash or a combination of the two.
The cash offer of A$1.10 a share closes on Thursday.

Cairn chief executive Bill Gammell said in a statement the flood of acceptances showed there was strong demand for shares in the U.K.-based resources group and confidence in the future of the merged companies.
Command shares closed at A$1.10 on Friday but have traded above the offer price recently on speculation that a counter offer may emerge.
The offer, which until Friday included an alternative of two Cairn shares for every 13 Command shares, values Command at A$354.5 million.
